decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes old-contract NFTs and their transfer-linked state from the active system while preserving the transfer rules for replacement-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active-system metadata to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy metadata without leaving incompatible metadata keys.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already requires random no-referral recipients to own an NFT from the active replacement contract and explicitly excludes old-contract owners.

The accepted decision excludes old-contract NFTs from the active Harbor Quill system, but it does not make those still-existing NFTs undiscoverable in owners' external wallets. The existing Event overstates the impact.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Despite the lost copies in the old contract, which don't worry me much, I think proceeding this way would be best.

value_updates.included_nft_contract_scope: Harbor Quill dashboard discovery covers NFTs from the active replacement contract only; old-contract NFTs remain on-chain and may still be visible in external wallets

decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY correctly limits Harbor Quill dashboard rendering to replacement-contract NFTs without changing external-wallet rendering semantics.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active ownership and mint reporting to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy NFTs from active-system counts and listings.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits book-access eligibility to replacement-contract NFT holders and excludes old-contract NFTs from granting active-system access.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts referral, ticket, and payout reporting to replacement-contract NFT data and excludes legacy-contract reward data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already establishes fresh replacement-contract draw state and excludes old-contract activity from platform statistics.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already directs eventual Transak mints to the active replacement contract; the provider and fiat-flow attributes remain valid unchanged.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes USDC wallet mints to the active replacement contract without changing the USDC payment behavior.
The accepted fresh-state migration policy is already represented by the candidate's message-539 INTRODUCE Event, so no additional propagated MODIFY is required.
